question_or_symptom: A nominal per-kind completion limit can undercount the records retained by one session when queue and signal work become ready together.
observation: Queue completion construction releases a queue inflight credit before its frame is sent, while prior queue completions may remain queued. The safe outbound bound is 25 records: eight old queue completions, eight newly admitted queue completions, eight signal waits/completions, and one synchronous ACK. A ready signal remains busy until its full frame is sent.
conclusion: Backpressure limits must count each ownership cohort at the point it can coexist, and completion resources must live through complete-send success.
decision: Enforce the session-wide 25-record bound, retain signal wait resources through socket send completion, disconnect on send failure or overflow, and test queue-completion interleaving while signal ACK and completion records are outstanding.
invalidated_assumptions: An eight-record limit per operation kind protects the total outbound queue.
Constructing a completion is equivalent to delivering it to the peer.
